unitTitle: A2 capstone: handle a changing week
title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 12: A2 capstone: handle a changing week

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: First listen for why the week changed and what Nadia will do next. Then retell the exchange using one past event, one future plan, one comparison and one polite request.

steps.title: Move a study meeting
steps.body: Nadia and Sam arrange a new time for their French study group.

examples.fr: La réunion est jeudi, pas mardi. Mardi, je travaille jusqu'à 17 h.
examples.en: Nadia: The meeting has been rescheduled. On Tuesday, I work until 5 p.m.

examples.fr: Je comprends. Est-ce que jeudi est possible ?
examples.en: Sam: I understand. Is Thursday possible?

examples.fr: Oui. La deuxième option est plus pratique que mardi.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes. The second option is more practical than Tuesday.

examples.fr: Je vais prévenir les membres du groupe et leur donner le nouvel horaire.
examples.en: Sam: I am going to tell the group members and give them the new schedule.

examples.fr: Pourriez-vous aussi confirmer le point de départ ?
examples.en: Nadia: Could you also confirm the starting point?

examples.fr: Bien sûr. Le groupe part du centre après le cours.
examples.en: Sam: Of course. The group leaves from the centre after class.

examples.fr: Je vais en parler à Marie et je vais lui envoyer un message.
examples.en: Nadia: I will tell Marie about it and send her a message.

examples.fr: Parfait. Ensuite, nous faisons un essai sans aide.
examples.en: Sam: Perfect. Then we will do an attempt without help.

steps.title: Handle an unexpected route change
steps.body: Karim describes a bus delay and confirms the new route with a classmate.

examples.fr: Il pleuvait quand le bus est arrivé, et j'ai pris un nouvel itinéraire.
examples.en: Karim: It was raining when the bus arrived, and I took a new route.

examples.fr: Tu as lu l'avis de service ?
examples.en: Nadia: Did you read the service notice?

examples.fr: Oui. Le nouvel horaire indique un départ près du centre.
examples.en: Karim: Yes. The departure point is moved near the centre.

examples.fr: Je vais demander le point de départ à l'employée.
examples.en: Nadia: I am going to ask the staff member for the starting point.
Karim: Will you also ask her for the time?

examples.fr: Oui. Je vais y aller après le cours et y noter l'heure.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes. I am going there after class and note the time there.

examples.fr: Merci. Pourriez-vous me dire si l'arrêt est près de l'entrée ?
examples.en: Karim: Thanks. Could you tell me whether the stop is near the entrance?

examples.fr: Je ne sais pas encore. Je confirme le lieu avant de partir.
examples.en: Nadia: I do not know yet. I will confirm the place before leaving.

steps.prompt: Why does Nadia need to move the study meeting?
options: She works until 5 p.m. on Tuesday
The study group has no room
steps.explain: Nadia says she works until 17 h on Tuesday.

steps.prompt: What does Sam agree to tell the group?
steps.explain: He says he will tell the group the new schedule.

steps.prompt: What happened while Karim was waiting for the bus?
options: It was raining when the bus arrived
steps.explain: Karim says it was raining when the bus arrived.

steps.prompt: What does Nadia plan to ask the staff member?
options: The course level and test score
steps.explain: Nadia says she will ask for the address, and Karim asks whether she will ask for the time too.
